issue_title: [Bug] add() 操作缺乏并发控制：多进程/多线程同时 add 可能导致 ID 重复（last-writer-wins 数据丢失）
summary: Added POSIX file locking (fcntl.flock) to TodoStorage with an exclusive_lock() context manager. All mutation operations (add, mark_done, mark_undone, remove) now use this lock to ensure atomic read-modify-write sequences across processes.
risks: Lock file (.todo.json.lock) is created alongside the database file; users should be aware of this additional file
fcntl.flock is POSIX-only; Windows would need msvcrt.locking or a cross-platform library like portalocker
limitations: Only works on POSIX systems (Linux, macOS); Windows support would require additional work
Lock files are not automatically cleaned up on abnormal termination, though the lock itself is released
